```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r warning = FALSE}
library("pacman")
pacman::p_load(dada2, phyloseq, Biostrings, ggplot2, stringr, patchwork)
```

DADA2 pipeline.

The following steps must be followed for each of the sequencing runs necessary to create our data. S5005 S6464 S6465 S8275

This script was processes in a Linux server.

### S5005

```{r}
path1 <- "/mnt/xio/lf/metabolon/data/S5005"
lf1<-list.files(path1)
lf1
```

Primer_forward (S-D-Arch-0519-a-S-15; Klindworth et al. 2012): "TCGTCGGCAGCGTCAGATGTGTATAAGAGACAGCAGCMGCCGCGGTAA" "CAGCMGCCGCGGTAA" 15 bases

Primer_reverse (S-D-Bact-0785-a-A-21; Klindworth et al. 2012): "GTCTCGTGGGCTCGGAGATGTGTATAAGAGACAGGACTACHVGGGTATCTAATCC" "GACTACHVGGGTATCTAATCC" 21 bases

```{r}
fq <- scan(file=paste0(path1,"/",lf1[2]),what=character())
length(fq)/5

primer1 <- which(str_count(fq,"CAGC[:alpha:]GCCGCGGTAA")>0)
length(primer1)/(length(fq)/5)

primer2 <- which(str_count(fq,"GACTAC[:alpha:][:alpha:]GGGTATCTAATCC")>0)
length(primer2)/(length(fq)/5)
```

Forward and reverse fastq filenames have format: SAMPLENAME_R1_001.fastq and SAMPLENAME_R2_001.fastq

```{r}
fnFs_5005 <- sort(list.files(path1, pattern=".1.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
fnRs_5005 <- sort(list.files(path1, pattern=".2.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
```

```{r}
plotQualityProfile(fnFs_5005[1:4])
```

```{r}
plotQualityProfile(fnRs_5005[1:4])
```

Extract sample names, assuming file names have format: SAMPLENAME_XXX.fastq

```{r}
sample.names_5005 <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fnFs_5005), "\\."), "[",1)
```

Place filtered files in filtered/ subdirectory

```{r}
filtFs_5005 <- file.path(path1, "filtered", paste0(sample.names_5005, "_F_filt.fastq.gz"))
filtRs_5005 <- file.path(path1, "filtered", paste0(sample.names_5005, "_R_filt.fastq.gz"))
names(filtFs_5005) <- sample.names_5005
names(filtRs_5005) <- sample.names_5005
```

```{r}
out_5005 <- filterAndTrim(fnFs_5005, filtFs_5005, fnRs_5005, filtRs_5005, 
                          truncLen=c(240,200), trimLeft=c(15,21),
                          maxN=0, maxEE=c(2,2), truncQ=2, rm.phix=TRUE,
                          compress=TRUE, multithread=TRUE)

out_5005

saveRDS(out_5005,"S5005_out.rds")
```

```{r}
errF_5005 <- learnErrors(filtFs_5005, multithread=TRUE)
plotErrors(errF_5005, nominalQ=TRUE)
saveRDS(errF_5005,"S5005_errF.rds")

errR_5005 <- learnErrors(filtRs_5005, multithread=TRUE)
plotErrors(errR_5005, nominalQ=TRUE)
saveRDS(errR_5005,"S5005_errR.rds")
```

```{r}
dadaFs_5005 <- dada(filtFs_5005, err=errF_5005, multithread=TRUE)
dadaRs_5005 <- dada(filtRs_5005, err=errR_5005, multithread=TRUE)

saveRDS(dadaFs_5005, "S5005_dadaFs.rds")
saveRDS(dadaRs_5005, "S5005_dadaRs.rds")
```

Merge paired reads

```{r}
mergers_5005 <- mergePairs(dadaFs_5005, filtFs_5005, dadaRs_5005, filtRs_5005, verbose=TRUE)
saveRDS(mergers_5005, "S5005_mergers.rds")
```

Construct sequence table

```{r}
seqtab_5005 <- makeSequenceTable(mergers_5005)
dim(seqtab_5005)
saveRDS(seqtab_5005, "S5005_seqtab.rds")
```

Remove chimeras

```{r}
seqtab_5005_nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab_5005, method="consensus", multithread=TRUE, verbose=TRUE)
dim(seqtab_5005_nochim)
saveRDS(seqtab_5005_nochim, "seqtab_5005_nochim.rds")

sum(seqtab_5005_nochim)/sum(seqtab_5005)
```

Track reads through the pipeline

```{r}
getN_5005 <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
track_5005 <- cbind(out_5005, sapply(dadaFs_5005, getN_5005), sapply(dadaRs_5005, getN_5005), sapply(mergers_5005, getN_5005), rowSums(seqtab_5005_nochim))

colnames(track_5005) <- c("input", "filtered", "denoisedF", "denoisedR", "merged", "nonchim")
rownames(track_5005) <- sample.names_5005
head(track_5005)
```

## Assign taxonomy

Merge all the sequence tables:

```{r}
seqtab_all <- mergeSequenceTables(seqtab_5005_nochim, seqtab_6464_nochim, seqtab_6465_nochim, seqtab_8275_nochim)
saveRDS(seqtab_all, "seqtab_all.rds")
```

```{r}
taxa1 <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab_all, "/mnt/xio/lf/metabolon/SILVA/silva_nr99_v138.1_train_set.fa.gz", multithread=TRUE, tryRC=TRUE)
saveRDS(taxa1, "taxa1.rds")
```

Add species:
```{r}
taxa <- addSpecies(taxa, "/mnt/xio/lf/metabolon/SILVA/silva_species_assignment_v138.1.fa.gz")
saveRDS(taxa, "taxa_species.rds")

```

Inspect taxonomy assignment:

```{r}
taxa.print <- taxa # Removing sequence rownames for display only
rownames(taxa.print) <- NULL
head(taxa.print)
tail(taxa.print)

```

### Handoff to phyloseq

Import metadata and convert date format (from dd.mm.yyyy to yyyy-mm-dd)
```{r}
sample_info <- read.table("Sample_info_mod_updated_VB_Luan_all_2024_1.txt",header = TRUE)
sample_info$Date <- as.Date(sample_info$Date, format = "%d.%m.%Y")
sample_info$Day <- as.character(sample_info$Day)

sample_info_CeGaT_ID <- sapply(strsplit(basename(sample_info$CeGaT_ID), "\\."), "[",1)

```

check whether rownames of setab.nochim.rds are the same as sample_info$CeGaT_ID:
```{r}
identical(rownames(seqtab_all),sample_info_CeGaT_ID)
rownames(seqtab_all)==sample_info_CeGaT_ID

rownames(seqtab_all) <- sample_info_CeGaT_ID
rownames(sample_info) <- rownames(seqtab_all)

```

Create phyloseq object
```{r}
ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(seqtab_all, taxa_are_rows=FALSE), 
               sample_data(sample_info), 
               tax_table(taxa))

samples_to_keep <- sample_names(ps)[!sample_names(ps) %in% "S5005Nr85"]
ps.1 <- prune_samples(samples_to_keep,ps)

ps.rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps.1, function(OTU) OTU/sum(OTU)) #it only worked when removed the sample with zero reads

top20 <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps.rel), decreasing=TRUE))[1:20]
ps.top20 <- prune_taxa(top20, ps.rel)

plot_bar(ps.top20, x="Sample_Info", fill="Genus") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top20, x="Sample_Info", fill="Order") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top20, x="Sample_Info", fill="Phylum") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")


top30 <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps.rel), decreasing=TRUE))[1:30]
ps.top30 <- prune_taxa(top30, ps.rel)

plot_bar(ps.top30, x="Sample_Info", fill="Genus") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top30, x="Sample_Info", fill="Order") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top30, x="Sample_Info", fill="Phylum") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")


top40 <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps.rel), decreasing=TRUE))[1:40]
ps.top40 <- prune_taxa(top40, ps.rel)

plot_bar(ps.top40, x="Sample_Info", fill="Genus") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top40, x="Sample_Info", fill="Order") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top40, x="Sample_Info", fill="Phylum") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")


## Be careful! Sample S5005Nr75.1.fastq.gz (triplicate)has error only psedomonas! -> I removed from ps3:
samples_to_keep2 <- sample_names(ps.1)[!sample_names(ps.1) %in% "S5005Nr75"]
ps.2 <- prune_samples(samples_to_keep2,ps)
length(samples_to_keep2)
ps.2

#Merge duplicate samples
sample_data(ps.2)
merged.ps <- merge_samples(ps.2,get_variable(ps.2,"merge_factor"))
merged.ps

#Create new metadata table, order alphabetically and paste to merged.ps
sample_data(merged.ps)
sample_info_merged <- subset(sample_info, Duplicate == 1)
sample_info_merged <- sample_info_merged[order(sample_info_merged$Sample_Info),]
dim(sample_info_merged)

#Check if the data and sample_info are in the same order
identical(rownames(sample_data(merged.ps)),sample_info_merged$Sample_Info)

row_name <- sample_info_merged$Sample_Info
row_name

rownames(sample_info_merged) <- row_name
sample_data(sample_info_merged)

sample_names(merged.ps)
rownames(sample_info_merged)

#Paste the new metadata table to merged.ps and check
sample_data(merged.ps) <- sample_info_merged
sample_data(merged.ps)
identical(sample_data(merged.ps)$Sample_Info, sample_names(merged.ps))

#Save merged metadata to use in other R sessions
write.csv(sample_info_merged, "Sample_info_merged_all_1.csv")

#Save merged phyloseq object to use in other R sessions
saveRDS(merged.ps, "merged.ps.rds")

#Assign the name of the lowest known taxonomic rank for every NA value in each ASV
# Opt1: Unknown <taxa>
merged.ps <- name_na_taxa(merged.ps) 
# Opt2: NA <taxa>
ps_tmp1 <- name_na_taxa(merged.ps,
                       include_rank = F,
                       na_label = "NA <tax>")

## remove initial sample (system probably not completely set up)
samples_to_keep3 <- sample_names(merged.ps)[!sample_names(merged.ps) %in% "L1_1_3_29_Mar_21"]
merged.ps <- prune_samples(samples_to_keep3,merged.ps)

saveRDS(merged.ps, "merged.ps.na.rds")


```

```{r}
ps.rel <- transform_sample_counts(merged.ps, function(OTU) OTU/sum(OTU))

#Verifications before going to next step
min(rowSums(otu_table(merged.ps)))
max(rowSums(otu_table(merged.ps)))
min(rowSums(otu_table(ps.rel)))
max(rowSums(otu_table(ps.rel)))

top20 <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps.rel), decreasing=TRUE))[1:20]
ps.top20 <- prune_taxa(top20, ps.rel)

plot_bar(ps.top20, x="Sample_Info", fill="Genus") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top20, x="Sample_Info", fill="Order") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top20, x="Sample_Info", fill="Phylum") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")


top30 <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps.rel), decreasing=TRUE))[1:30]
ps.top30 <- prune_taxa(top30, ps.rel)

plot_bar(ps.top30, x="Sample_Info", fill="Genus") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top30, x="Sample_Info", fill="Order") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top30, x="Sample_Info", fill="Phylum") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")


top40 <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps.rel), decreasing=TRUE))[1:40]
ps.top40 <- prune_taxa(top40, ps.rel)

plot_bar(ps.top40, x="Sample_Info", fill="Genus") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top40, x="Sample_Info", fill="Order") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
plot_bar(ps.top40, x="Sample_Info", fill="Phylum") + facet_wrap(~Lane, scales="free_x")
```
